issue.title: Consumption parity: reconcile, task_complete retirement, and bob-plugins adopt capture's keep-notes, only-emptied, identity matching
issue.description:
Proposed by the bob-cli-7n land agent from plan:202610/capture_star_blocks.md §8 ("Deliberately not doing"). The plan named these as follow-ups ("Parity is a follow-up (§8)"), but no phase recorded a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note for them.

Epic bob-cli-7n gave capture (`&`, `*`, and the link-guard Consume branches) a capture-only consumption behaviour through `task_status_hooks::apply_blocked_consumption_with_options` (src/native/task_status_hooks/structure.rs ~553-628) with `keep_notes` / `only_emptied`:
- PDL8: a consumed link-only bullet with children keeps its notes as plain text.
- PDL9: an entry is deleted only when this capture emptied it.
- PDL10: links match by resolved `(path, block id)` identity.
- PDL11: removals are reported.

Three other consumption/retirement paths still use the older behaviour:
1. `bob task reconcile` blocked-link consumption (`sync.rs` ~426 and ~1258). It removes the whole subtree (PDL7) and deletes every childless entry via `plan_empty_pomodoro_removals`.
2. `task_complete` retirement (`src/native/task_complete/retirement.rs:168`). It calls `plan_empty_pomodoro_removals`, so a completion deletes every childless Pomodoro entry, including unrelated placeholders it never touched. That is the class of defect bob-cli-7l fixed for capture.
3. bob-plugins Depends-On consumption, which removes the whole subtree.

The result is that the same Blocked task's Task Link loses its authored notes, or an unrelated placeholder entry vanishes, depending on which surface consumed it.

Proposal: decide whether reconcile, task_complete retirement, and bob-plugins should adopt capture's PDL8–PDL10 (keep notes, only-emptied, identity). Record the decision, then implement it, with parity vectors in docs/task-dependencies.md §13.14.

Out of scope for bob-cli-7n because the accepted plan deliberately kept reconcile/plugins on PDL7 in v1. Changing it needs its own decision and touches reconcile and bob-plugins, not just capture.

task_type_fields.proposal: Bring reconcile blocked-link consumption, task_complete retirement's empty-entry pass, and bob-plugins Depends-On consumption to capture's PDL8 keep-notes, PDL9 only-emptied, and PDL10 identity matching, after recording the decision.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-7n plan (§3, §8) deliberately kept reconcile and plugins on PDL7 for v1. Parity needs its own decision and spans reconcile, task_complete, and the bob-plugins repo.

issue.creation_reason: Epic bob-cli-7n made capture consumption keep notes, delete only entries it emptied, and match by identity, but deliberately deferred the same behaviour for reconcile, task_complete retirement, and bob-plugins, leaving surfaces inconsistent.

payload.entry: Both halves landed under decision consumption_parity=yes. bob: ff1a7524 (bob-cli-h8.12) moves reconcile and task_complete retirement onto keep-notes, only-emptied, and identity matching, and never deletes a closed row with recorded time. plugins: bob-plugins 9d24e42 (bob-cli-h8.13) does the same for Depends-On consumption, with docs in 4fa96e15. docs/task-dependencies.md §13.14 PDL7-PDL14 pins the parity vectors. The decision record is decisions:consumption-keeps-notes-and-recorded-time. bob-plugins full npm test passes the dependency-consumption suites in UTC and New York (2026-11-05).
